Title: STEPS +2
Review: This album has the same nostalgic upbeat energy from any other classic city pop album, but the songs elicit so many different emotions in me each time I listen. In your eyes makes me feel like I am floating. It's inexplicable depth captures the soul of finding both peace and ecstacy when looking into the eyes of someone you love. Refrain brings a bittersweet upbeat energy that feels like you are wishing the best for someone you loved very deeply but is no longer in your life. The sadness, joy, and passion all form a beautiful union to process such difficult emotions.

Title: Finally Rich
Review: A recurring question I ask people is: what's your favorite Chief Keef song? I have managed to split people up into three categories based on their responses: those who have no idea who Chief Keef is and are thus completely tapped out of the scene, individuals who are aware of Chief Keef and maybe one or two of his songs(usually Love Sosa or Hate Bein' Sober), and people who will pull out something ridiculous like Laughin to the Bank. I personally love Chief Keef, and this album is what started it all. At 15 years old, Chief Keef went into the studio and dropped this iconic album. No one in the music industry EVER had this kind of motion at 15 years old. IU and Aaliyah debuted at similar ages didn't drop Finally Rich. Even though the album doesn't have particularly deep messages, its very existence as one of the most iconic and influentual albums ever made(it basically kickstarted the drill scene) is nothing short of mindboggling.

Title: Kind of Blue
Review: I find myself naturally resisting things regarded as the "greatest" in any category. Widely regarded as the greatest jazz album of all time, Kind of Blue holds a mythical level of hype and prestige amongst music enthusiasts. One day, I decided to sit down and listen to it from start to finish, and I realized why. Miles Davis is a magic man. In my opinion, music, in addition to all other art, is important if it can stir up emotion with you. The tecnhical talent and artistic ability to produce something so polished and honest is beyond anything I could ever hope to achieve even if I had one hundred years to try.
